events.text: Evandro Brandão was born.

events.text: Brandão joined Walsall.

events.quote: before joining Walsall in 2003

events.text: Brandão signed for Manchester United.

events.quote: Brandão signed for Manchester United on 21 October 2006

events.text: Brandão was offered a trainee contract.

events.quote: before being offered a trainee contract in July 2007

events.text: Brandão made his debut for the reserves in 2008–09.
events.subject: self
events.quote: He also made his debut for the reserves in 2008–09

events.text: Brandão was released on the expiry of his contract.

events.quote: was released on the expiry of his contract in June 2009

events.text: Brandão signed with Braga.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Brandão signed with Braga in the summer of 2009

events.text: Benfica signed him on a two-and-a-half-year contract.
events.subject: self
events.quote: just five months later , the deal was usurped by Benfica , who signed him on a two-and-a-half-year contract

events.text: He went out on loan to Fátima.

events.quote: he went out on loan twice in 2010–11 , first to Fátima

events.text: He went out on loan to Gondomar.
events.subject: self
events.quote: and then to Gondomar ( third division )

events.text: Brandão moved to Hungarian club Videoton.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Brandão moved to Hungarian club Videoton in July 2011

events.text: Brandão scored his first and only Nemzeti Bajnokság I goal for the side.
events.subject: self
events.quote: He scored his first and only Nemzeti Bajnokság I goal for the side on 20 August

events.text: Brandão signed with Olhanense on loan.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In the summer of 2012 , Brandão signed with Olhanense in the Portuguese top flight , on loan .

events.text: Brandão scored his first goal in the competition on 15 December.
events.subject: self
events.quote: He scored his first goal in the competition on 15 December

events.text: Brandão agreed to a deal at Fafe.
events.subject: self
events.quote: On 12 July 2016 , he agreed to a deal at Fafe from the Portuguese second tier .

events.text: Brandão scored his first hat-trick at the professional level.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Brandão scored his first hat-trick at the professional level on 15 January 2017

events.text: Brandão signed for Leixões.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In June , following relegation , he signed for Leixões also of the second division .

events.text: Brandão joined Israeli Liga Leumit club Maccabi Petah Tikva.
events.subject: self
events.quote: On 10 September 2019 , Brandão joined Israeli Liga Leumit club Maccabi Petah Tikva .

events.text: Brandão switched allegiance to Angola as a senior.
events.subject: self
events.quote: He switched allegiance to Angola as a senior

events.text: Brandão made his debut on 13 August 2014 by playing the last four minutes of a 0–0 friendly draw to Angola.
